description: Latest cash grain price for one commodity in one state, from USDA MARS daily market reports — the same series get_grain_history extends over time. Use for a current quote; use get_grain_history instead for trends across days. Read-only lookup of stored reports; no API key. Returns the most recent report's price with its unit (USD per bushel in most markets) and market location; a commodity/state pair with no report returns a no-data error rather than a stale price.

geography.description: State/region code from a tracked MARS report (e.g. IL, IA, TX, PNW, GULF). Default: IL

name: get_grain_price
